integration: UIRewardEntry composes a child ItemSlot.prefab. VMRewardEntry contains Item (VMItemSlot/SyncMetadata) and Claimed (bool/SyncVisible), in that order.
Host assigns Item.Text, Item.Icon, Item.IconVisible and product-defined Item.type. Reward only displays its claim marker; it never owns grant rules.
Install ItemSlot v5 first. Keep BagIconNew child name so existing animation paths remain valid. Reward-native materials retain only claim-marker and outer animation assets.
UIRewardEntry.Unref sets Item=null before base.Unref, releasing the child subscription. Static instances should not repeatedly Ref; Fancy reuse retains the existing framework cache limitations.
Unref preserves the item data: temporarily clear Item to release the child subscription, unsubscribe the parent, then restore the same Item. Recycled cells may bind the same reward model again.

Icon is a string asset path resolved by existing SyncSprite/UILoader. IconVisible expresses host visibility intent, not loading completion. Mail does not load Sprite or maintain image callbacks. Shared loader cancellation and out-of-order completion need separate validation.
